answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The upshot is a network where trust is a resource you earn, not a quantity you can mint — and that is what keeps Sybil attacks economically unviable.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a bridge as the anchor of the cost.
